data.narrative:
Corvex Systems is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jason Blick that has raised $5M+. The valuation analysis draws on a broader comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including companies such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

A peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient narrowly-filtered comparables; only one same-stage peer existed in the robotics sector, falling short of the three-datapoint threshold required for reliable peer triangulation. Accordingly, the analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $5M total raised proxy. This method implies a valuation of $12M.

The triangulated range supports a median valuation of $12M, with a low estimate of $11M and high estimate of $14M. The range reflects conservative application of stage-based progression absent a robust peer dataset. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly-matched comparables at seed stage within the sector and the reliance on a single quantitative method. A more granular valuation would benefit from either additional seed-stage robotics peers or disclosure of Corvex's specific revenue, unit economics, or product-readiness metrics relative to the broader comp set.
